Government is a little different, though. In cost-plus government accounting, you don’t absorb your own costs and then just hope to make a profit based on the price you charge. You get to charge the government for everything you spend, plus a profit fee on top of it. But if you are building two of something, you only need to do the design work once. The real overspending in government contracting for things like this is usually attributable to two different things.
